# [Feat] dsv4.1: add vit rope kernel opt for dsv4.1.

## Motivation
This pr is separated from #43856 . DeepSeek-V4.1 Flash’s vision tower applies half-split RoPE on Q/K in every ViT attention layer. The current path is an eager PyTorch implementation (chunk + cat with FP32 math), which is correct but relatively expensive on the encoder critical path—especially under EPD / high image concurrency, where ViT RoPE is invoked repeatedly per token and head.This pr adds a fused CUDA vision-RoPE kernel through SGLang’s JIT framework.


<!-- Describe the purpose and goals of this pull request. -->

## Modifications

- support optimized vit rope kernel .
  - Add a fused CUDA kernel for vision apply_rotary / apply_vision_rotary.
  - Keep the same API as the eager path and gate it with SGLANG_DSV41_VIT_ROPE_CUDA.
<!-- Detail the changes made in this pull request. -->

## Accuracy Tests
In the DeepSeek V4.1 Flash tech report, the VLM benchmark dataset appears to have only been used to test the base model. So we tested dsv4.1 on MMMU_PRO dataset (1730 samples) on colocate and epd deployment for accuracy correctness, and get the corresponding score.
